front: What happened to Zillow Offers in 2021?
back: Zillow announced in November 2021 that it would wind down the home-buying business after large inventory write-downs, citing difficulty in forecasting home prices.
Sellers accept offers that are above their private value, so the homes you buy are biased towards your model's overestimates.

front: Why compare forecast error with margin?
back: If typical error is larger than the margin per trade, many trades lose money even when the model is unbiased on average.

front: Why do regime changes hurt trading on forecasts?
back: Errors become correlated: all assets move together, so diversification does not remove the risk.

front: Name controls for trading on a forecast.
back: Probabilistic forecasts, conservative quantile offers, calibration on traded deals, bias monitoring, exposure limits, stress tests, human override.

front: What is a feedback loop in this case?
back: Your own buying and resale speed change the market and the data you will see next, so the future differs from the past.
